item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00334","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C14","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 is an unmistakable drafting template for the child. The directives use nearly identical language and the same single-sentence legal machinery: designating an Associate Justice of Puerto Rico's Supreme Court to act as federal district judge, authorizing the signing of papers and records, withholding extra compensation, specifying vacancy/death/absence/illness/disability contingencies, and limiting the designation to a calendar year. The child principally substitutes Benjamin Ortiz for A. Cecil Snyder and changes 1952 to 1953. C14 and C01 are also close predecessors, but they omit the expanded vacancy-and-death contingencies found verbatim in C19 and the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable Benjamin Ortiz, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico","parent_excerpt":"I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico","explanation":"Identical opening appointment formula and office, with only the designee changed."},{"child_excerpt":"to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico, and to sign all necessary papers and records as acting judge of the said district court, without extra compensation","parent_excerpt":"to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the District Court of the United States for Puerto Rico, and to sign all necessary papers and records as acting judge of the said district court, without extra compensation","explanation":"Substantially verbatim statement of the delegated judicial functions and compensation condition; the court's name is only reordered."},{"child_excerpt":"in case of vacancy in the office of judge of the said district court, or in case of the death, absence, illness, or other legal disability of the judge thereof, during the year 1953","parent_excerpt":"in case of vacancy in the office of judge of the said district court, or in case of the death, absence, illness, or other legal disability of the judge thereof, during the year 1952","explanation":"The complete triggering conditions and annual duration are copied verbatim apart from the year."}]}
